description: React component for a contour control popover in a data visualization interface, allowing users to configure contour types, thresholds, colors, and validation logic.

methods.name: isIsoband
methods.description: Determines if the given contour object qualifies as an isoband based on threshold properties.

methods.name: getTabKey
methods.description: Returns the tab key ('ISOLINE' or 'ISOBAND') based on the contour object.

methods.name: determineErrorMap
methods.description: Validates contour thresholds and stroke width, returning an error map.

methods.name: convertContourToNumeric
methods.description: Converts threshold and stroke width properties of a contour object to numbers.

methods.name: formatIsoline
methods.description: Formats a contour object for isoline display.

methods.name: formatIsoband
methods.description: Formats a contour object for isoband display.

methods.name: ContourPopoverControl
methods.description: Main React component managing contour configuration popover with validation and save logic.
